title: Mobility Equipment Class Reference — Codes, Coverage Criteria and Build Standards
content:
# Mobility Equipment Class Reference

Every wheelchair Summit Ridge Home Medical furnishes under Mobility Equipment belongs to one of six classes, each identified by its HCPCS code. The class fixes the coverage criteria set the patient must meet, the highest patient weight the class is rated for, and the build the furnished chair must meet for its code.

## 1. Entry criteria by class

| Class | Mobility limitation | Further criteria | Patient weight, at most (lb) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Manual Wheelchair (K0001) | impairs mobility-related activities of daily living in the home | self-propels or has a willing caregiver | 250 |
| Lightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0003) | as K0001 | cannot self-propel a standard chair but can a lightweight one | 250 |
| High-Strength Lightweight Wheelchair (K0004) | as K0001 | cannot self-propel a lightweight chair; needs features unavailable on K0003 | 250 |
| Ultralightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0005) | as K0001 | full-time manual user; specialty evaluation and ATP involvement | 250 |
| Group 2 Standard Power Wheelchair (K0823) | as K0001 | cannot safely use either a manual chair or a scooter; able to operate a power chair safely; face-to-face examination required; home assessment required | 300 |
| Group 3 Complex Rehab Power Wheelchair (K0856) | Group 2 criteria | neurological condition, myopathy or congenital skeletal deformity; specialty evaluation and ATP involvement; face-to-face examination required; home assessment required | 300 |

## 2. Code, type and coverage criteria set

| Class | HCPCS code | Manual or power | Coverage criteria set the patient must meet |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Manual Wheelchair (K0001) | K0001 | manual | mobility limitation |
| Lightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0003) | K0003 | manual | lightweight need |
| High-Strength Lightweight Wheelchair (K0004) | K0004 | manual | high-strength need |
| Ultralightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0005) | K0005 | manual | full-time ultralight |
| Group 2 Standard Power Wheelchair (K0823) | K0823 | power | power need |
| Group 3 Complex Rehab Power Wheelchair (K0856) | K0856 | power | complex rehab power |

## 3. Build the furnished chair must meet

The frame weight band is the band of the class as defined by its code. The minimum top speed and the minimum range on one charge apply to the power base and are 0 for manual chairs. A custom-configured chair is configured to the patient's measurements and cannot be resold.

| Class | Frame weight band | Highest patient weight rated (lb) | Minimum top speed (mph) | Minimum range on one charge (miles) | Accepts a power seating option such as tilt | Custom-configured |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| K0001 | over 36 lb | 250 | 0 | 0 | no | no |
| K0003 | 34 to 36 lb | 250 | 0 | 0 | no | no |
| K0004 | under 34 lb | 250 | 0 | 0 | no | no |
| K0005 | under 30 lb | 250 | 0 | 0 | no | yes |
| K0823 | not applicable (power base) | 300 | 3 | 7 | no | no |
| K0856 | not applicable (power base) | 300 | 4.5 | 12 | yes | yes |

## 4. Reading the reference

- **Which classes are power bases?** Group 2 Standard Power Wheelchair (K0823) and Group 3 Complex Rehab Power Wheelchair (K0856); they are the only classes with a speed and range minimum above 0.
- **Which classes accept a power seating option?** Only K0856.
- **Which classes are custom-configured?** K0005 and K0856.
- **Weight example (hypothetical).** A patient recorded at 260 lb is above the 250 lb rating of the four manual classes and within the 300 lb rating of the two power classes.
